#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

double EPS = 1E-10;

vector<double> crossSimple(long x, long y, long r, long tx, long ty, long tr) {
    long d2 = (tx - x) * (tx - x) + (ty - y) * (ty - y);
    if (d2 < (r - tr) * (r - tr)) return {}; // covered or covering
    if (d2 > (r + tr) * (r + tr)) return {}; // not intersects or touched
    double base = atan2(ty - y, tx - x);
    double cosVal = (double)(d2 + r * r - tr * tr) / (2.0 * sqrt((double)d2) * r);
    if (cosVal > 1.0) cosVal = 1.0;
    if (cosVal < -1.0) cosVal = -1.0;
    double wing = acos(cosVal); // Law of cosines
    double inf = base - wing, sup = base + wing;
    return {inf, sup};
}

double d2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {
    return (bx - ax) * (bx - ax) + (by - ay) * (by - ay);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<long>> co(n, vector<long>(3));
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> co[i][0] >> co[i][1] >> co[i][2];
    }

    vector<vector<double>> nodes(10);
    int p = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            auto ts = crossSimple(co[i][0], co[i][1], co[i][2], co[j][0], co[j][1], co[j][2]);
            for (double t : ts) {
                nodes[p++] = {
                    co[i][0] + co[i][2] * cos(t),
                    co[i][1] + co[i][2] * sin(t)
                };
            }
        }
    }
    nodes.resize(p);
    int q = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
        bool skip = false;
        for (int j = i + 1; j < p; j++) {
            if (d2(nodes[i][0], nodes[i][1], nodes[j][0], nodes[j][1]) < 1e-12) {
                skip = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (skip) continue;
        nodes[q++] = nodes[i];
    }
    nodes.resize(q);
    int nnodes = q;
    int ne = 0;
    int con = 1;
    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
        int e = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < q; i++) {
            if (abs(d2(nodes[i][0], nodes[i][1], co[j][0], co[j][1]) - co[j][2] * co[j][2]) < 1e-12) {
                e++;
            }
        }
        if (e == 0) con++;
        ne += e;
    }
    if (con > n) con = n;
    cout << (ne - nnodes + con + 1) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
